from event_packet import EventPacket
from sequencer import sequence_stream_batch

    p1 = EventPacket("s1", 1, "low")
    p2 = EventPacket("s2", 5, "high")
    res = sequence_stream_batch([p1, p2])
    assert res[0].severity == 5

    p1 = EventPacket("s1", 1, "low")
    p2 = EventPacket("s2", 5, "high")
